task.title: Inputting a renewal week with an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction

step.cmd: Determine if a completed Claimant’s report: Original without pay coding — Checklist or Claimant’s report: Original with pay coding — Checklist is included for the antedate period:

ul.li: If no and fact-finding is required, go to Returning the file to Integrity . fact-finding Returning the file to Integrity

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the Integrity registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 26 - Processing of a report blocked by a renewal week .
Remarks line 1: Type “Antedate renewal from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2–4: Enter the claimant’s report details and any allocation information.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Infraction: Select C - Non-fraud - Insurability - new information .
Message: Select 38 - An overpayment resulted due to a change in the start of your claim .

step.cmd: In NIIS, determine if Integrity identified fraudulent ROEs:
In RCM, determine if the fraudulent ROEs have been deleted:
In RCM, open each ROE identified as fraudulent in NIIS by Integrity and delete them as follows:

ul.li: Additional information: Type “Investigation has been completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status. (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”

step.cmd: Determine if the following text appears in the Additional information section of the deleted ROE: “Investigation has been completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status. (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”

ul.li:
If no, add the text as follows:
Additional information: Type “Investigation has been completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status. (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”
Select Validate .
Select Submit .

step.cmd: Determine if there are any fraudulent ROEs in the QP of one of the client’s established claim:
Determine if any fraudulent ROEs were used to calculate one of the client’s established claim:
In NWS, create an AI WI as follows:

ul.li: Destination — Level: Select 1 - Natl Processing & Payment Svcs (PPS) / Specialized EI Processing / ISB Post Audit Processing .
End user: Select Next available user .
BPC: Enter the BPC requiring a recalculation.
Comments: Type “Integrity confirmed that ROEs [serial numbers] are fraudulent. The ROEs have been deleted. Recalculate the client’s claim. Ensure the banking information and address are correct.”
Source Details: Enter the Integrity case number.

step.cmd: Determine if there is a contentious reason for separation (RFS) that requires adjudication in the QP:
In FTS, determine the BPC:

ul.li: If the BPC is between w/c 2310 and w/c 2361, go to step 13.
If the BPC is between w/c 2258 and w/c 2309, go to step 14.

If the BPC is between w/c 2230 and w/c 2257 and it is a claim for special benefits other than sickness benefits, adjudicate each contentious FRS issue, unless the decision can be deferred. Go to step 15.
If the BPC is w/c 2362 or after, adjudicate each contentious FRS issue, unless the decision can be deferred. Go to step 15.
If the BPC is between w/c 2230 and w/c 2257 and it is an EI ERB claim, go to step 17.

step.cmd: Determine is there is a contentious RFS in the QP on the most recent ROE that belongs to the client:

ul.li:
If yes, do the following:
Open the corresponding RFS issue (i.e. the automatically resolved ROD with Adjudication not required ).
Decision Options: Select Decision no longer valid .
Select OK .
Adjudicate the contentious RFS from the most recent ROE belonging to the client.
Go to step 15.

step.cmd: Determine if the client is requesting regular or sickness benefits:

ul.li: If no, adjudicate each RFS issue requiring adjudication on a contentious RFS, unless the decision can be deferred. Go to step 15.

step.cmd: Determine if a negative decision must be communicated in writing to the client due to a deleted fraudulent ROE:

In ACS, create and send the D-01-00-00 letter for regular benefits, or the N-00-00-00 letter for special benefits. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
If a disqualification has been imposed, the client is requesting regular benefits and does not have enough hours since the contentious RFS to qualify, select the following attributes:
Disqualifications - Definite/Indefinite - Previous/Current/Revision (2970): Select D11 / D10 / Both / Previous Disq / Revision (Initial/Renewal or Revised) .
D11 / D10 / Both / Previous Disq / Revision - Initial or Renewal or Revision (2542): Select Disqualification message for Initial Claim .
Disqualification message for Initial Claim (2543)
D11 / D10 - Date of event = BPC/Date of event prior to BPC/ Date of event after BPC (2544): Select Date of event = BPC or Date of event prior to BPC and the appropriate sub-options.
D11 / D10 - Min hrs for reg/ Insufficient hrs reg/ Insufficient hrs reg fishing (2545):
If the client has not worked since the event, select Min hrs required to qualify for regular benefits .
If the client has worked since the event and it is obvious there are insufficient hours since the event to qualify, select Insufficient hrs accumulated since event for regular or Insufficient hrs accumulated since event for regular and insufficient fishing earnings for fishing benefits .
If the client has worked since the event, but the information or knowledge to complete this block is missing, select Min hrs required to qualify for regular benefits .

If the client is requesting regular benefits and has enough hours since the contentious RFS to qualify, select the following attributes:
Various issues affecting claim establishment and benefit rate (2500): Select ROE excluded due to voluntary leave not just cause or misconduct .
Text: Name of employer(s) (1502): Enter the employer’s name.
D11 message - D10 message (2463)

If the client is requesting special benefits and does not have enough hours since the contentious RFS to qualify for regular benefits, select the following attributes:
Special Benefits Approved (3046): Select the appropriate BT and options.
Not entitled to regular after special: - (D10/D11) or claim is BPNE) - Initial or Renewal claim or D42 -D43 (2540): Select (D11/D10) imposed - Only special benefits allowed .
D11/D10 imposed - Only special benefits allowed (2491)
Text: Name of employer(s) (1502): Enter the employer’s name.
Date of event (1292): Enter the appropriate date.
D11 min hours for regular/not enough hours regular/not enough hours regular and not enough earnings fishing (2545):
If the client has not worked since the event, select Min hrs required to qualify for regular benefits .
If the client has worked since the event and it is obvious there are insufficient hours since the event to qualify, select Insufficient hrs accumulated since event for regular or Insufficient hrs accumulated since event for regular and insufficient fishing earnings for fishing benefits .
If the client has worked since the event, but the information or knowledge to complete this block is missing, select Min hrs required to qualify for regular benefits .

If the client is requesting special benefits and has enough hours since the contentious RFS to qualify for regular benefits, select the following attributes:
Various issues affecting claim establishment and benefit rate (2500): Select ROE excluded due to voluntary leave not just cause or misconduct .
Text: Name of employer(s) (1502): Enter the employer’s name.
D11 Message - D10 Message (1503) .
Special Benefits Approved (3046): Select the appropriate BT and options.
If a disentitlement has been imposed, select Disentitlements (2976) .
If an allocation of earnings has been input, select Allocation of Earnings (2516) .

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
If there is no resulting OP, select Blank .
If the client has an active claim, select Overpayment – No misrepresentation and active claim .
If the client does not have an active claim Overpayment – No misrepresentation and inactive claim .
Right to Request Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to request a Reconsideration .

step.cmd: Create the ROD on the client’s application and not on the fraudulent application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — fraudulent renewal.”

Details: Type “The investigator confirmed the client’s address and banking information on: [DD-MM-YYYY]. The client’s address is: [client’s address]. The client’s banking information is: [client’s banking information].” If Integrity identified fraudulent ROEs, also type “Integrity confirmed that ROE [serial number] is fraudulent.” Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD on the fraudulent renewal application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — renewal submitted by a third party.”

Details: Enter the following information:
Relevant facts: Type “An EI renewal application was filed by a third party on [DD-MM-YYYY] using the client’s identity.”
Decision/Justification: Type “This renewal application was not filed by the client and must not be included in an access to information request.”

step.cmd: To delete the fraudulent application, create a REM WI as follows:

ul.li: Due date: Enter the next business day.
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

End user: Select Specific user:
Enter the name of the team leader or the designated person and select Find user .

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Decision tab of the IC70 Report of Investigation screen, close the case as follows:

ul.li:
Disentitlement: Select No .
Reason: Select Other and type “Fraudulent renewal. No OP to a third party.”
Overpayment: Do not check either box.

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI and all other related WIs.
